# Infra Checklist: Meeting Dashboard Review

**Purpose**: Validate platform, data, contract, and validation requirements quality before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-06-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the API and web route contracts defined for meeting list, meeting detail, and desktop-embeddable routes? [Completeness, Plan Phase 1]
- [x] CHK002 Are the existing data sources for meetings, processing, transcript segments, diarization, and dependency state documented without creating duplicate review storage? [Completeness, Research Decisions]
- [x] CHK003 Are list/detail view models defined separately from raw database rows and raw dependency payloads? [Completeness, Data Model]
- [x] CHK004 Are browser and desktop embedded route ownership rules documented, including fail-closed behavior for unknown routes? [Coverage, Embedded Route Contract]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is the valid auth/session context requirement clear at the product contract level without weakening auth for local browser convenience? [Clarity, Spec FR-001/FR-003, Quickstart]
- [x] CHK006 Are performance expectations quantified for MVP list/detail responses and list-to-detail navigation? [Clarity, Plan Performance Goals, Spec SC-001]
- [x] CHK007 Are implementation validation commands listed for focused and full server checks? [Clarity, Quickstart]
- [x] CHK008 Are screenshot/evidence hygiene rules documented before implementation begins? [Clarity, Quickstart Scenario 7]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK009 Are ready, processing, degraded, failed/blocked, partial, no-meetings, unauthorized, and embedded-unavailable scenarios represented in requirements or quickstart validation? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases, Quickstart]
- [x] CHK010 Are future web-only routes such as contacts, action items, broad admin, billing, public share, export/download, retention, and deletion excluded from embedded scope? [Coverage, Embedded Route Contract]
- [x] CHK011 Are route contracts explicit that `New` cannot start native recording from the web cabinet in 016? [Consistency, UI State Contract]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK012 Are dependencies on prior features 013, 014, 015, 030, 031, and 032 recorded before tasks are generated? [Dependency, Spec Assumptions]
- [x] CHK013 Is the absence of a new frontend build system intentional and documented with alternatives considered? [Decision, Research]

## Notes

- Infra checklist passes. The auth/session detail is intentionally a product-contract requirement; implementation must reuse existing authenticated/RLS dependencies rather than introduce dev bypasses.
